text:
Derek: Kicked off canary for kernel 5.19.12 + fw 1.4.2 on pool-gpu-na-west. Seeing Xid spikes ~10m after canary start, attaching quick logs.
Derek: ```\n[2026-03-18T10:12:03Z] Xid 31 at seq 3421 gpu0
[2026-03-18T10:12:07Z] ECC corrected errors increasing on gpu0
[2026-03-18T10:12:15Z] Xid 31 repeated 5 times in 60s
``` 
deploy-bot: canary started on pool-gpu-na-west nodes: gpu-na-west-1,gpu-na-west-2,gpu-na-west-3,gpu-na-west-4
Maria: baseline xid/sec for these racks? did we change any runtime params for the canary?
Derek: baseline ~0.02 xid/s per card. observed ~0.4/s on gpu-na-west-3. No change to batching or vfio config.
Kevin: can you paste the PromQL you used to surface that spike?
Derek: ```\nsum(rate(nv_gpu_xid_total[5m])) by (instance)
```\nI'm alerting on `> 0.2` for 10m as a canary signal.
Jess: single-card delta makes me suspect hardware/flaky card or a driver/firmware handshake edge. Temps OK? thermal throttling?
Derek: temps are steady ~62C, no throttle events in syslog.
Maria: ops plan: if Xid per-instance >0.2 for >15m we rollback kernel on canary nodes and drain the affected instance. Also bump telemetry sampling on canary pools from 0.1 -> 1.0 so we catch sequence/timestamp deltas.
ops-bot: INC-2026-345 created for gpu-na-west canary Xid spike :rotating_light:
Kevin: also add `nv_ecc_corrected_total` correlation in the dashboard; in previous runs ECC corrected rate preceded Xid by ~2-3 minutes.
Derek: I'll start a parallel canary switching driver to 510.85.2 (current 510.54.3) on gpu-na-west-3 and monitor. Starting now.
deploy-bot: rolling driver 510.85.2 to gpu-na-west-3 (canary) — started
Maria: note on capacity: NA-west pool is at 78% alloc. if we need to drain many nodes we must pre-evict low-priority jobs or risk PR backpressure. Can the scheduler pre-evict 4 small jobs?
Jess: running quick diag script on gpu-na-west-3, will paste output. ```\n/opt/tools/gpu_diag.sh --short
GPU0: ECC corrected: 124 in last 30m
GPU0: memory-test: pass
GPU0: pci-link flaps: 0
``` 
Derek: diag looks consistent with ECC correlation. if updated driver reduces ECC counts we'll keep canary; otherwise roll back and open hardware replacement for gpu-na-west-3.
Maria: also increasing KV cache logging for this canary so we can see any prefetch/reuse regression. set TTL to 600 -> 1800 for canary only.
deploy-bot: telemetry sample rate updated for pool-gpu-na-west to 1.0 for the duration of the canary
Derek: will post metrics snapshot in ~30m. if Xid rate stays >0.2 and ECC corrected climbs we rollback and schedule replacement. :thumbsup:
